---
description: Prepare a release checklist, changelog/release notes, validation, migration notes, and deployment readiness review.
---
Prepare this repository for a release according to its existing versioning and release conventions. Review current changes, breaking changes, migrations, dependencies, config/environment changes, tests, builds, artifacts, and deployment prerequisites. Use the workspace DAG, distinguish CI/deployment-dispatch/live-provider/production evidence, and preserve the protected `develop` → `main` release flow. Draft release notes/checklist. Do not tag, push, publish, or deploy unless explicitly requested.
